text_block_list.text:
At Матиканэфукукитару's request, I head
to the
park one night.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we have an emergency on our
hands!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The sky is so jam-packed full of stars
that some of
the constellations fell right
out of it.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Have a look!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, hehe. These are
zodiac-themed
chocolates, made with
extra thought and care!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Today's Valentine's Day, after all. It's
only natural
for someone who enjoys
fortune-telling to take
any and all
celebrations seriously.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Are you giving all of those chocolates to me?

text_block_list.text:
Of course not! You just eat the one that

corresponds with your zodiac. That's
what makes
it extra special.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
So, which one is yours? What's your birth
month
again?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I look for the chocolate that corresponds
with my
zodiac... but I notice one of the
chocolates is
much, much bigger than all
the others. What's
that about?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What's that you're looking at? Hmm,
that one is...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Gyahhhhh! My Leo and Scorpio
chocolates have
melted into one
another!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Sigh. I knew I shouldn't have winged it. I'm a total novice when it comes to making sweets.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: So what star sign is it now?

text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? It's Leo and Scorpio
stuck
tog—oh, I see! It's a manticore!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The lion-scorpion hybrid from Persian
mythology!
We've given birth to a new
star sign!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Go on, try one. I'm sure even Zeus would
be
shocked by how good these taste!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
So, which one is yours? What's your birth
month
again?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Well, I'm a Gemini, so...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
My Gemini chocolate is twice the size of
the
others to account for both Castor
and Pollux.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Right? Actually, I want you to do me a
favor...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Can you share it with me? Sharing is
caring, after
all.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
We split the chocolate in two. For some
reason,
doing so seems to make it taste
even sweeter...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yum! I prefer it this way! Way better
than the
nerve-racking act of just giving
someone a gift.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Sweet and simple, right? We get to
share our
thoughts too. So, how was the
chocolate?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, glad to hear it. Happy Valentine's
Day,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
We eat the chocolates together,
accompanied by
Fukukitaru's steady
commentary. It makes for
quite the
amusing Valentine's Day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My plan was to make you happy, but I'm
feeling
pretty tickled myself as well.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
